gre_subject.value: Neither the Optics PhD page nor the 2026-2027 Graduate Catalog states whether the GRE Physics Subject Test is required or optional.

supervisor.value: Whether prior supervisor agreement is required before admission is not stated; each admitted student joins a research group in optics.

funding.value: Assistantship or fellowship funding guarantees for the Optics PhD are not stated on the program page or in the Graduate Catalog.

entry_route.value: Requires an earned bachelor's degree in physics or a related field with intermediate-level preparation in mechanics, electricity and magnetism, and mathematical methods of physics.
entry_route.quote: All applicants are required to provide and/or meet: • Earned baccalaureate degree in physics or a related field.

notes: Research housed in the Center for Research and Education in Optical Sciences and Applications (CREOSA); 72 total credits required (typical duration 4-7 years full-time).
